title: Ad intelligence, Dailymotion protection and local alerts
message: Adds heuristic YouTube and Dailymotion ad-leak signals, anti-adblock warning detection and local notification history.
features: Heuristic YouTube ad-leak signals from visible markers and resource observations
Dailymotion-specific ad marker and resource detection
Anti-adblock warning detection and optional desktop notifications
Local event history with bounded storage and clear controls
Independent settings toggles with allowlist-aware behavior
Preserves existing filtering, allowlists, segment skipping and dashboard features
